characters.name: Manddatteren (the Man’s Daughter)
characters.prompt: A young woman dressed in simple Norwegian peasant clothing from the 1400–1850 period, with a humble yet determined expression. She has braided hair, slightly worn shoes, and carries spinning tools. Her posture is upright and confident, reflecting her kind and hardworking nature.

characters.name: Kjærringdatteren (the Stepmother’s Daughter)
characters.prompt: A young woman in worn but slightly gaudier Norwegian attire from the 1400–1850 era. She appears lazy and self-centered, with an impatient or haughty expression. Her hair is somewhat disheveled, and she holds unkempt spinning materials.

characters.name: Stepmother (Kjærringen)
characters.prompt: An older Norwegian woman from the 1400–1850 timeframe, wearing drab, practical clothing, with a stern face and sharp, critical eyes. She carries herself stiffly, reflecting her harsh personality and favoritism toward her own daughter.

characters.name: Trollkjærringen (the Troll Woman)
characters.prompt: An eerie, hunched figure wearing ragged, old-fashioned Norwegian garments. She dwells in a shadowy, old farmstead. Her skin is weathered, she has tangled hair or a kerchief, and carries a sense of mystical menace fitting a 1400–1850 Norwegian folktale.

characters.name: Trollkjærringens datter (the Troll Woman’s Daughter)
characters.prompt: A younger troll figure in tattered Norwegian clothing of the 1400–1850 period, resembling her mother but with a slightly less ominous appearance. She lurks near the Trollkjærringen’s dwelling, often watching with curious or cunning eyes.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Create a single scene set in rural Norway between 1400 and 1850. Show both Manddatteren, dressed in humble peasant clothes, and Kjærringdatteren, dressed in slightly more tattered attire, seated by an old stone well while spinning. Include subtle details of the lush green meadow, a wooden fence, a spotted cow with a milk pail, and an apple tree heavy with fruit. In the distance, depict a small farmyard or cottage, suggesting a mysterious presence of the Trollkjærring’s domain. Use a style reminiscent of traditional Norwegian folk art, with rich, warm color tones and rustic charm.
modernMainImagePrompt: Illustrate the story in a modern setting: two teenage girls in today’s casual clothes competing to do chores in a suburban backyard with a small kiddie pool representing the well. Replace the historic farm details with a contemporary house, a modern fence, and a city skyline in the distance. The troll figure appears as a mysterious neighbor in a run-down house, keeping a sense of the folktale’s magic but in a clearly current era.
childMainImagePrompt: In a bright and whimsical style, show two friendly-looking girls wearing colorful, playful outfits. They sit near a cartoonish water well under a big smiling apple tree with rosy apples. Include a gentle, smiling cow and a mischievous but not scary troll peeking out from a cozy little cottage. Soft lines, pastel colors, and cheerful expressions should dominate the illustration to appeal to a five-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et lyst og enkelt bilde av de to jentene i et gammelt norsk gårdstun frem mot 1800-tallet. Den ene jenta står ved en brønn og spinner med flittighet, mens den andre hviler seg med en litt sur mine. Vis en gårdsplass med et lite gjerde, en ku som venter på å bli melket, og et epletre fullt av fristende epler. Hold stilen enkel og klar, med moderne norsk språk i eventyrlige detaljer.
englishMainImagePrompt: Depict the tale in an old Norwegian farm setting between the 15th and 19th century. One hardworking girl is spinning beside a traditional well, and another lazier girl stands nearby in the same yard. Show an apple tree heavy with fruit, a spotted cow, and a humble cottage. A shadowy figure of a troll woman lurks by a distant gate, adding a hint of mysterious folklore. Use a soft, storybook illustration style that preserves the original fairytale atmosphere.
